euclideanLagrangian: L_E=(1/(2U)) dot(theta)^T G dot(theta)+u sum_i(1-cos theta_i)

theorem.kineticSchurBound: for fixed dot(theta_i), dot(theta)^T G dot(theta) >= dot(theta_i)^2/(G^-1)_ii
theorem.windingActionBound: every nonzero integer winding obeys S_E >= 8 sqrt(u/(22U))
theorem.proofSketch: choose any coordinate with nonzero winding, apply the Schur kinetic bound and V>=u(1-cos theta_i), then integrate the AM-GM line element over at least one full 2pi traversal
theorem.straightCoordinateTrialAction: all G_ii=4, so a straight single-coordinate path has S_E=16 sqrt(u/U)

experimentalUse: offset-charge or twisted-boundary spectroscopy should find any compact charge-dispersion scale below the perturbative anharmonic shifts and exponentially decreasing with 1/sqrt(U/u); a larger or nonexponential signal rejects the ideal joined Hamiltonian or exposes uncontrolled phase slips
established: a rigorous Euclidean action floor for every nontrivial compact winding of the Gram-first joined Hamiltonian
boundary: The action floor rigorously bounds the semiclassical exponent, not the fluctuation determinant or total tunnelling amplitude. Multi-instanton combinatorics, dissipative renormalization, offset charges and ultraviolet junction physics can alter the prefactor. The straight path is a trial upper action, not the minimizing instanton.
epistemicStatus: exact metric and variational action theorem; exponential amplitude estimate remains semiclassical because its prefactor is unbounded
